subject: Elevate intro demo into POC design session — need to move calendar
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@stratusai.com>
To: ava.chen@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro to Redwood Inference — quick demo?

Hi Ava —

Thanks for the quick connect last week at CloudSummit. We’re evaluating inference runtimes and I’d love a 30–40 minute intro demo of Redwood for our engineering and ML leads. High-level goals: lower token costs, stable tail latency, and on-prem options for regulated customers.

Is there availability this week or early next? We have Eric (Head of ML) and one of our infra folks joining. I attached a short architecture snapshot so you can tailor the session.

Attachments: Stratus_Stack_Overview.pdf (application/pdf)

Best,
Samira Khan
Director of Product, StratusAI
samira@stratusai.com
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@stratusai.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro to Redwood Inference — quick demo?

Hi Samira —

Appreciate the context and the architecture diagram — helpful. Given Eric and an infra lead are joining, would you be open to turning the 30–40 minute intro into a focused POC design session instead? That would let us:
- walk through a proposed integration plan for your stack,
- pin down required telemetry/audit hooks, and
- sketch a minimal scoping plan and success criteria for a short POC.

If yes, I can loop in our solutions engineer (Lauren) and our infra lead (Marcus) to run a 60–75 minute technical scoping session. Proposed windows (PDT):
- Tue 2026-08-11 10:00–11:15
- Wed 2026-08-12 14:00–15:15
- Thu 2026-08-13 09:00–10:15

If those don’t work, tell me what time zone constraints you have and we’ll find a match. Lauren, Marcus — can you both confirm availability for any of the above? If we pivot to a POC session I’ll also send a short prework doc so Eric can prioritize evaluation goals.

Thanks —
Ava Chen
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0192
From: Samira Khan <samira@stratusai.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eric Wong <eric.wong@stratusai.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro to Redwood Inference — quick demo?

Thanks, Ava —

On Mon, Aug 10, 2026 at 11:03 AM Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Appreciate the context and the architecture diagram — helpful. Given Eric and an
> infra lead are joining, would you be open to turning the 30–40 minute intro into a
> focused POC design session instead?

Yes — we prefer the POC design session approach. Two constraints: our Head of Revenue is traveling (red-eye back on Wed) and Eric has a board review on Thu morning, so earlier in the week is preferable. Our preferred windows (PDT):
- Tue 2026-08-11 10:00–11:30 (works best)
- Wed 2026-08-12 09:00–10:00 (possible but tight)

If you can do Tue 10:00 that’s ideal. For the session, Eric wants a short readiness checklist in advance (data connections, allowed egress, key-management options). He also asked whether you can include a brief runthrough of conversion metrics we should measure during a POC (latency percentiles, token cost per active session, success-rate metrics).

I’ve attached the stack doc you requested.

Attachments: Stratus_Stack_Overview.pdf (application/pdf)

—Samira
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: Samira Khan <samira@stratusai.com>, Eric Wong <eric.wong@stratusai.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2026 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Elevate intro to POC design session — Tue 08/11 10:00 accepted — prep and ask

Folks — forwarding the thread. Stratus confirmed Tue 2026-08-11 10:00–11:30 PDT for a POC design session (Eric + infra + Head of Revenue may drop in). Travel and board constraints drove the choice; they want a technical scoping session rather than a product-lite demo.

Quick checklist / asks before the session (please reply inline if anything won’t be ready):
- Marcus: can you prepare a short runbook that covers integration options (prefix caching, KV eviction policy, quantization impact) and a one-slide latency/cost tradeoff summary.
- Lauren: please create a 2-slide POC success criteria template (what to measure: p50/p95/p99 latency, token cost per session, end-to-end success-rate, request sampling for quality checks) and a 1-page prework doc for Samira’s team. I attached a blank template you can reuse.
- AV/invite: I’ll send the calendar invite and include the HubSpot record + a Drive folder with prework.

Attachments: POC_Prework_Template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

We’ll aim to keep the session tight and leave 15 minutes for deployment/next steps and a mutual action plan. Marcus/Lauren — can you confirm you’re available at Tue 10:00?

Thanks —
Ava
